tex_content.html:
Lemma
[Jacobi identity in Leibniz form]

↗ lem:dc-ch0-5-2

1. ch0:5.3For differentiable vector fields $X,Y,Z$ one has $[X,[Y,Z]]=[[X,Y],Z]+[Y,[X,Z]]$.
Proof

\sketch

Evaluate both sides on a differentiable function $f$. Expanding each bracket as a commutator of derivations gives $XYZf-XZYf-YZXf+ZYXf$ on the left and the same four terms on the right after cancellation of the repeated middle terms. By uniqueness in section 4, the two vector fields are equal.

□
